sections.what_happened: China TAO spokesperson Zhang Han (regular briefing, Oct 21): coast guard vessels near Pratas are 'safeguarding order' / 'fulfilling duties in accordance with the law'; Beijing claims 'indisputable sovereignty' over Pratas; DPP's 'separatist stance' is the 'root cause of the peril of war'. Taiwan Coast Guard: Chinese ship entered restricted waters near Pratas on Tuesday; vessel Taichung dispatched; radio exchange captured the dispute; standoff was continuing at report time. Follows Oct 14 water cannon incident (Taiwan vs Chinese fishing boat) and Beijing's 'bear the consequences' warning, plus two Chinese approaches since Sunday. Parallel: USS Charleston FONOP at Sabina Shoal — first publicly reported US FONOP in SCS in over a year; China sent naval forces to monitor (US FONOP typically unannounced; Chinese Southern Theatre Command framed as illegal intrusion). >100 Chinese ships along the first island chain since Saturday (Joseph Wu); Liaoning carrier in Western Pacific; warships with cruise missiles as close as 24nm from Taiwan (Su Tzu-yun: ship-launched sea-skimmers could hit in ~3 minutes). US Congress commission chair (Taipei forum, Tuesday): Chinese east-coast patrols 'highly destabilising'; Wu: China has no legal claim off the island's east.
sections.what_verified: Reuters wire carried verbatim by DevDiscourse, FreeMalaysiaToday; Taiwan officials (Wu, Pan Chun-kuang, Su Tzu-yun) on record; ISW map 'PRC Multi-Directional Maritime Harassment of Taiwan October 17-18' circulating on social channels (ISW/Facebook)
sections.what_disputed: Taiwan government rejects all Beijing sovereignty claims ('only Taiwanese people can decide their future'); Taiwan frames actions as provocative grey-zone harassment; US commission calls patrols 'highly destabilising'; security experts warn Pratas vulnerable to seizure (400+ km from Taiwan); TOTW editorial stance (China side) must still label Beijing's sovereignty claims as claims
sections.why_matters: The jurisdiction war in 30 seconds: China names its patrols law enforcement under 'indisputable sovereignty'; Taiwan answers on open radio that it is 'a sovereign and independent country' — map the two claims, the 24nm missile math, and the first US FONOP in a year watching from Sabina. Map spine, source tags on every claim.
